description: Run pinned kicad-happy schematic checks offline. Findings are compact and enabled by default; optional booleans add focused top-level report fields. Analysis instructions: /scratch/pkg/node_modules/kicad-copilot-mcp/docs/analysis.md

all.description: Return every optional schematic report field. Does not override findings=false.

assembly.description: Return package mix and estimated hand/professional assembly complexity.

blocks.description: Return detected functional blocks such as regulators, crystals, filters, and interfaces.

bom.description: Return compact BOM, sourcing coverage, missing properties, and optimization observations.

buses.description: Return detected buses, interfaces, differential pairs, and cross-domain signals.

connectivity.description: Return unconnected pins, single-pin nets, multi-driver nets, labels, and no-connect data.

findings.description: Return compact actionable findings. Disable when only focused report fields are needed.

hierarchy.description: Return sheets, hierarchical ports/labels, and hierarchy discovery warnings.

overview.description: Return structured project size and schematic statistics.

path.description: Path to a .kicad_sch, .kicad_pro, or KiCad project directory.

power.description: Return rails, voltage estimates, power tree, budget, sequencing, sleep current, and PDN observations.

verification.description: Return test coverage, protocol checks, and compact analysis trust coverage.

name: analyze_schematic
title: Analyze KiCad Schematic
